# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `squarespace` MCP server pointing at Squarespace's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp`).
- No credentials to configure: the Domains tools are public, so the server answers an unauthenticated `tools/list`.
- Documented that the Commerce tools stay hidden until Squarespace extends sign-in beyond Claude and ChatGPT.
- Logo: Squarespace's official mark, from the developer site's brand assets.
